description: issue #687 (slice I8): with `interaction-events` active, redefining the profile primitive `wait` raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/tooling.md:185` -- redefining a *primitive* collides regardless of whether it is also a reserved block-head). `wait` is NOT one of the profile's four reserved block-heads (`spec/interaction-events.md` reserves only `when`/`every`/`on_key`/`on_click`), so this is the primitive branch of the rule -- a distinction #838 kept in the code and removed from the DIAGNOSTIC, since spec/error-model.md:125 now gives `params: { name }` only and forbids the word *primitive* from reaching the learner. Before I8, `wait` was the only one of those four profiles' primitives a program could silently shadow: it was registered in the reader's arity table but in none of the checker's gates. The span covers the declared name, not the `define` keyword. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.

diagnostics.message: wait is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
